items: Nutcracker doesn't check `new stream<T, C>(obj)` against `obj.next()`'s return type — worth an issue

findings.title: `next()` makes line 28 invalid
findings.body: `...|error?` doesn't satisfy `stream<int, error>`, so jBallerina also rejects line 28. Drop the `?`; both compilers then report only line 29.

outputs.jBallerina:
ERROR (28:33) incompatible types: expected '(record {| int value; |}|error)', found '(record {| int value; |}|error)?'
ERROR (29:14) incompatible types: expected 'stream<int>', found 'stream<int,error>'
outputs.Nutcracker: error[SEMANTIC_ERROR] 29:9 incompatible arguments for function call

findings.suggestion: public isolated function next() returns record {|int value;|}|error {
